title: Shop online
objectives: use e-commerce and online shopping vocabulary

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Greet student and introduce lesson objectives for Shop online.
Welcome to today's lesson: Shop online! Today we will practice how to use e-commerce and online shopping vocabulary.

elements.content: use e-commerce and online shopping vocabulary; understand delivery and order confirmations

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Introduce target vocabulary and key language structures using concept check questions.

elements.content: Review key terms and target language below:
Key terms: internet, order, website, delivery, buy

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Check understanding through controlled choice exercise.

elements.content: What is the final step after placing an order online?

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Develop reading comprehension and listening skills.

teacherNotes.title: Listening Tapescript
teacherNotes.content: I buy my clothes online. The website is easy to use and delivery takes two days.

elements.content: Read the short passage below (recycling introduced vocabulary):
I like to shop online. I visit the website, choose my order, and wait for delivery.
Listening Task: Listen to your teacher / audio prompt and answer the comprehension question.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Provide communicative speaking practice and personalized interaction.

elements.content: Explain how you order items online on your favorite shopping websites.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Review key corrections and confirm homework task.
Great work today! Remember to review target words in your mobile app before our next class.

elements.content: Today you practiced: use e-commerce and online shopping vocabulary, understand delivery and order confirmations.
